purpose: Deterministic trigger regression cases for the ten Standard skills. Each case is a realistic user prompt plus the skill that should be selected (null means no MathModel skill applies).
note: Used by scripts/check_skill_triggers.py, which scores prompts against skill descriptions with a lexical TF-IDF proxy. That proxy is not a model-based routing test; it exists to catch description collisions and borrowings between skills.
